title: IIT Kharagpur Kolkata Campus
text:
In addition to the Kharagpur Campus, the college has three extension centers at Kolkata, Bhubaneshwar and Raipur. The extension provides venue for programs under Continuing Education Programme, IIT Kharagpur and also provides Guest House accomodation.
